definitions.gloss: close friend, best friend, intimate friend
definitions.explanation: A friend with whom one has a very close and trusting relationship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{親友|しんゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶりに→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met up with a close friend from childhood after a long time.

examples.japanese: {親友|しんゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}でも→何でも：00304_nandemo⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I can talk about anything with my best friend.

examples.japanese: {親友|しんゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦しまって→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧。
examples.english: My best friend moved away and I feel lonely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{親友|しんゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{会|あ}って→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I still meet up with my best friend from university every month for a meal.

notes:
{親友|しんゆう} implies a deeper, more intimate level of friendship than ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧. Someone you trust completely and can confide in.

COMPOUND: {親|しん} (close/intimate) + {友|ゆう} (friend)

FRIENDSHIP HIERARCHY:
- ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧: acquaintance
- ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧: friend (general, everyday term)
- ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧: friend (more formal/written)
- {親友|しんゆう}: close/best friend (deep trust)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {親友|しんゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become close friends
- ⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{親友|しんゆう}: lifelong best friend
- ⟦{無二|むに}→無二：24982_muni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{親友|しんゆう}: one and only best friend
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{親友|しんゆう}: best friend since childhood

REGISTER:
Slightly formal compared to ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧. Used in both spoken and written Japanese.
